## What this adds

<!-- A technical note, a skill for the catalog, or a site change. -->

## For a technical note

- [ ] The file is in my working group's folder under `src/content/notes/`
- [ ] The label matches where the work is in the publication track (`reviewed` only after the full track)
- [ ] `source` links to the document in the WG repository
- [ ] If the note names member companies or products, it describes them neutrally

## For a skill

- [ ] `source` points to the skill's repository, and `version` is pinned
- [ ] `license` and `maintainer` are filled in
- [ ] `executable` is `true` if the skill includes scripts
- [ ] New entries use `status: listed`
